scope: GP R3.1/R4 rendering integration CPU evidence; incremental real test batches and construction measurements. This is not a new full-game, hardware-renderer, Blender, or full-670-source CPU-suite claim.

subsequentFrozenBuild.scope: Final source/build identity captured after all integration and before the separately coordinated browser run; earlier CPU batches retain their individual scope above.

renderDrawCalls.status: a separate browser assertion, not a CPU draw measurement

caliperRepair.problem: Incoming GP-R1 high exceeded the existing complete-model gate in two independent tests: 110708 is not less than 110000.
caliperRepair.change: One bevel step instead of two, and 12 rather than 20 sides for the small piston cylinders. No threshold, authored profile curve, housing dimensions, bevel width/depth, mount, rotor slot, materials, hydraulic hose, or hardware placement change.

independentRegression.purpose: Both mirrored components preserve their observed incoming AABB and leave the actual rotor gap open; rays hit pad backing, not an unintended housing bridge.

geometryAccounting.scope: CPU production-constructor accounting after R3.1/R4 integration; expanded instances, no GPU draw-call measurement.

measurementMethod: Actual production constructors; sum (index count or position count) / 3 over every Mesh, multiplied by InstancedMesh.count. Counts include model geometry regardless of view; renderer submitted triangles are a separate future browser metric.
preservationAndScope: The incoming analytic chain routing, wheel-matched direction, even link count, midpoint-centred waisted plates, phase/culling envelopes, and replay-held buffer behavior supersede the older rectangular plate helper; the new chain module is byte-identical to upstream.
GP cooling-louver exterior screw-head winding is preserved from upstream; both sides pass the actual exterior-ray test.
BikeModel retains one idempotent disposal path for geometry and InstancedMesh buffers; the focused reference test confirms two instance-dispose events total after calling model.dispose twice.

The incoming GP fixture precompile call is retained together with expanded instance accounting, separately named submittedTriangles, three identical dry warmup samples, and all existing weather/held/rewind resource equalities.

GP disc glow is selected only for GP-R1/GP-R2. Shared BikeMaterials now allocates six paint maps per entrant, including dirt bikes; DirtBikeModel/rider reference none of paint/secondary/accent and retain separate dirt plastic materials. Existing BikeMaterials.dispose enumerates the new texture fields.

The MX250, MX450 and SM450 CPU controls use the production model, socket, pose, FOV and visibility contract across three aspect ratios and four articulation cases, then restore exterior arms and execute owner cleanup.
The incoming Blender authoring/review tools are preserved. No new Blender run or offline asset export is claimed by this integration record.
Brake-fade simulation and crowd integration are owned and validated separately; they are not included in these CPU test totals.
The older compatibility root and full-game eight-image main45 evidence remain their actual 667-source snapshot and are not relabelled by this record.
